# Vocabulary Notes

The source material uses several terms without agreed definitions:

- `request`, `ticket`, and `case` may refer to the same item or to different
  stages of work;
- `requester` may mean an employee, any staff member, or a volunteer;
- `service team` may mean the coordinators only or everyone who performs work;
- `urgent` has no shared threshold;
- `closed`, `completed`, and `resolved` are used interchangeably;
- `site` may refer to a physical location or an organizational unit.

No approved glossary exists.
